popCulture.title: Icarius (Athenian)
popCulture.description: Attic host of Dionysus who first shared wine — the shepherds, thinking themselves poisoned, kill him and hide the body that Erigone will find.

popCulture.title: Erigone (daughter of Icarius)
popCulture.description: Erigone's search and suicide begin from the shepherds' crime — the Aiora rites remember the murder that emptied Icarius' house.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Attic digression — the herdsmen who beat Icarius to death after the first wine, mistaking drunkenness for a charm.
